notes.title: COPPER ODYSSEY PHYSICAL RELEASE!
notes.content:
[h2]In Collaboration with Strangest.io....[/h2]
The Copper Odyssey Limited Physical Edition comes loaded with game disk, custom game manual art book, enameled pin, and a handscreened print that is signed by CAM. 
As of this post, there are only 25 copies of the Physical Edition left!ːWindiasmileː
